display_information.name: June
display_information.description: Raygen's personal companion, hosted in the homelab.
display_information.long_description: June is a personal companion hosted in Raygen's homelab. She responds to DMs and mentions with conversational replies and native reactions. Optional on-demand search uses Slack's Real-time Search API and returns source links without retaining retrieved content. Keyword search is supported; semantic search depends on Slack AI Search availability and requires a Business+ or Enterprise+ plan. User scopes are requested for planned private-channel and direct-message search, requiring separate user authorization. Historical imports are not enabled.
